description: Improved price CSV updates so blank values are skipped, restricted the update endpoint to admins, and separated quote and invoice numbering.
Added Stripe card authorization and delayed payment verification, with invoice tracking and admin controls to capture authorized payments.
Updated checkout to require a shipping address and send it with payment setup.
Added an admin payment capture action and an email when a card payment is authorized; records whether that notice was sent.
Fixed the product page to hide its inspiration section when it has no matching images.
Added product CSV export options, including manufacturer-specific and missing-image lists; corrected how tracking links are saved.
Prefilled checkout shipping details from the purchaser profile, kept the save-quote confirmation visible, and exposed tracking links in quote details.
Made payment setup requests unique to avoid reusing a Stripe idempotency key and showed Stripe error details when setup fails.
Added an Edit shipping action so buyers can revise their address and refresh payment setup before paying.
Locked the shipping state once a shipping quote exists, explained how to request a state change, and fixed the payment form outline.
